title: KR:013492:ANNEX:1
full_text:
ANNEX
STANDARDS FOR IMPOSITION OF ADMINISTRATIVE FINES (Related to Article 12)

1. General Criteria
The authority empowered to impose administrative fines may reduce the administrative fine amount specified in the individual criteria under paragraph 2 by up to one half if any of the following circumstances applies: Provided, That such reduction shall not apply to a violator who is delinquent in paying an administrative fine.

(a) Where the violation is deemed to have resulted from minor negligence or an error;
(b) Where the violator is deemed to have made efforts to rectify or eliminate the violation of the Act;
(c) Where a reduction is deemed necessary in consideration of the seriousness of the violation, the motive for the violation and its consequences, etc.

2. Individual Criteria
(Unit: 10,000 won)

| Violation | Statutory basis | Administrative fine (10,000 won) |
|---|---|---:|
| Using the name "Korea Maritime Transportation Safety Authority" or a similar name in violation of Article 17 of the Act | Article 21 (1) of the Act | 500 |

The fine in this row is KRW 5,000,000 before any permitted reduction under paragraph 1.
